description: "The Loss of the Kent, East Indiaman, in the Bay of Biscay" by Duncan McGregor is a historical account written in the early 19th century. This book recounts the harrowing events surrounding the shipwreck of the "Kent", an East Indiaman that tragically caught fire during a violent storm in the Bay of Biscay, leading to a desperate battle for survival among its passengers and crew.
